name: Leland Palmer
original_name: リーランド・パーマー
source:
[url=/c73545]Hitomi[/url] and Maria's English professor. He's been a lecturer at Midoriyama Academy for the past 6 months. He and Hitomi both witnessed Maria's kidnapping.

[spoiler]Leland has actually been a member of Snake the entire time. He infected Hitomi with the Ua virus, and contacted [url=/c74743]Daisuke Endo[/url] as an "organ trafficker" to lead him into attempting to kidnap Hitomi. He poses as his leader, [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url], during the finale while the real Alphard attempts to infiltrate Okoshi Pharmaceutical.[/spoiler]
